event: Wed 25 Nov 15:30 SAST: US October PCE inflation and Q3 GDP (2nd estimate). Thu 26 Nov: US Thanksgiving, markets shut; Fri short session. Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Bounce holding
bullets.text: Mitrade says gold rose to around 3,665 this morning, while FXStreet had it near 3,635 earlier in Asia, so the live price is UNVERIFIED but inside 3,635-3,666.

bullets.title: Big Monday rally
bullets.text: TradingNEWS had spot up almost 4% on Monday to about 3,678, with a high near 3,685, after Friday's 14-month low near 3,503.

bullets.title: Selling pressure eased
bullets.text: Reports say margin-call selling faded after Nvidia brought back its CEO and stocks bounced, which let gold recover.

bullets.title: Hike still expected
bullets.text: Markets still price a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December (about 92-95% by different sources), and the 50 bp bets have faded.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index was near 104.3, a 19-month high, and the 10-year yield near 4.92-4.94% on Monday; no fresh reading today (UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Trend still down
bullets.text: Gold lost about 9% last week and is still far below the 100-day average near 4,175, so this is a bounce inside a downtrend.

bullets.title: PCE on Wednesday
bullets.text: PCE and GDP at 15:30 SAST Wednesday can swing gold fast, and Thanksgiving on Thursday will thin trading.
